cluster_summary: This cluster comprises vulnerabilities in a document management system where privilege escalation arises from improper handling of document author identity during save operations, missing authorization checks on sensitive API methods and state-changing actions, and use of non-contextual permission checks that ignore current user context or dropped permissions. A distinct error handling flaw can also bypass authorization enforcement.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled resource identifiers, namespace IDs, tenant IDs, object IDs, or bulk-operation targets carried in a request body into bulk updates, synchronization operations, mutations, or administrative effects that act on those body-selected resources. Report code paths where the body-selected resources are not validated to match the URL path parameters or the resource identity used by the authorization check. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should validate every body-selected target against the path-scoped resource identity before the permission check and before the mutation.

mechanism.missing_guard: the body-selected resources are not validated to match the URL path parameters or the resource identity used by the authorization check
mechanism.name: request-body resource identifiers bypass path-scoped authorization
mechanism.sink_shape: bulk updates, synchronization operations, mutations, or administrative effects that act on those body-selected resources
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled resource identifiers, namespace IDs, tenant IDs, object IDs, or bulk-operation targets carried in a request body
mechanism.typical_fix: validate every body-selected target against the path-scoped resource identity before the permission check and before the mutation

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Add appropriate authorization checks (e.g., privilege verification, CSRF token validation) before allowing the operation, and return read-only wrappers for mutable objects when the caller lacks necessary rights.
sub_patterns.name: Missing authorization checks on sensitive API methods or state-changing operations
sub_patterns.root_cause: Sensitive operations such as retrieving mutable author objects, modifying document authors, or saving over existing documents are performed without verifying the caller's privileges or without CSRF token validation, assuming that the request is legitimate.
